ms.report:
Thank you all for you kind words and for the approvals. To address the one reviewer who is questioning if a pilot has been launched. I must admit I am confused. We have shared the details of the pilot that is live with Rosebank (this was in fact the one agreement we've been able to share publicly). You can see it again here - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TnVpndWHw5V4uvDLusnaGjZINAixSaNV/view
As of Friday we just heard the good news this project has sold out (10 months ahead of schedule). I appreciate you couldn't have known this while reviewing the last submission. You can see the latest update here - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qLIoO20hocy4qyB5Do3g2O9HGpB8hZFt/view?usp=sharing
We have delivered a fully functional platform with audited smart contracts. With a platform that is up to the standard of the NSE so they can begin to promote this publicly. We have conversations with other African exchanges, other property partners and funders in varous stages including the contract stage. We are being invited by the largest housing development bank on the continent to present our solution to their partners as part of the securing of capital for phase two - https://www.linkedin.com/posts/shelter-afrique_africaurbanforumdealroom-aufdr-activity-7448276987095203840-iqh5/?rcm=ACoAAABVtKQBW5xWAJNyRCl16HNyX-r4tl7ekvA
And our pilot project is sold out 10 months ahead of schedule. I feel very strongly we have more then delivered on the proposal and need the funding committed to keep up this momentum.
